title: Falso Soporte TI y Fatiga MFA / Push Bombing (Scattered Spider)
description: El estafador desencadena múltiples notificaciones push de MFA y llama haciendo pasar por soporte informático exigiendo pulsar Aprobar.
dialogue: Hi Sarah, this is Mike from Global IT Security. We are currently seeing a cluster of anomalous login attempts trying to access your Microsoft 365 environment.
Your phone has been buzzing with Authenticator push approval requests. Do not ignore them. It is a credential stuffing attack in progress.
I need you to hit Approve on the very next push prompt that pops up so our security backend can synchronize your device token and lock out the hostile IP.
